_comment: Copy this file to ~/.gmail-mcp-private/accounts.json and put in your real accounts. One entry per Gmail/Workspace account: alias = the short name you use in tool calls ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+, unique); email = the exact address (unique); scope = 'modify' (read + label/archive + draft, never permanent delete) or 'readonly'. enable_send=false means no send tool is exposed; arming send ALSO requires GMAIL_MCP_ALLOW_SEND=1 in the server's environment, so a config edit alone can never enable sending. export_roots: named folders exports may write into; each must already exist, be owned by you, and not be group- or world-writable. pdf: PDF stays off until the three budgets are set from your own measurements AND tools/render_gates.py --write-record has passed on this machine's Chrome (see README). label_admin=true registers create/update/delete/undo label tools; delete_label refuses labels with more than label_delete_max_messages messages.
